policyReview.matching: Exact normalized words and phrases plus exact punctuation-obfuscated tokens; arbitrary spaced-letter substrings, phone-number masking, and ambiguous surnames are excluded to avoid false positives.

removals.reason: When a text-only, low-quality, or principally promotional part was removed, every surviving sibling from the same accepted source was also removed if retaining it would omit source rows. After text curation, whole works with identical retained output were deduplicated by preferring the earliest dated or archive-year source, then a stable lexicographic source ID when chronology was tied or unavailable.
